Waiting for GTA 6 on PC? What Rockstar's Past Launches (and the Emulator Scene) Can and Can't Tell You 🖥️

carousel // Nov 18, 2026 · Updated Nov 20, 2026

See it on TikTok

PC players have been here before. GTA V took roughly nineteen months to make the jump from consoles. This time there’s another contender in the conversation: the people trying to run PS5 games on a PC.

November 20 update

A GTA VI entry appeared in the KytyPS5 issue tracker on launch day. The person who filed it asked to test the game and supplied no emulator version, log or footage. The maintainer closed it that day. The entry establishes interest in testing. Whether GTA VI can boot on that emulator remains unverified. November 19 issue and closure

Could GTA VI reach PC through an emulator first?

Rockstar launched GTA VI on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Its launch announcement gives no PC release date. A native PC edition would run directly on the computer. An emulator would have to run the PS5 edition there. Those are two different bets. Rockstar’s launch announcement

Why GTA V started the conversation

The game in the early emulator reports was the PS5 edition of GTA V. Getting as far as its menus gave testers a way to see what happened when they tried to load the city. The monitor on the card is an illustration. July menu report

How long did Rockstar’s PC ports take?

With GTA V, Rockstar shipped the PC version years before anyone demonstrated the PS5 edition running in an emulator. The wait varied considerably across three Rockstar releases.

  • GTA V hit consoles in September 2013 and reached PC on April 14, 2015. That's about a year and a half. Rockstar Newswire
  • Red Dead Redemption 2 came out on consoles in October 2018 and reached PC in November 2019, about a year later. Rockstar Newswire
  • Red Dead Redemption launched on consoles in 2010 and only came to PC on October 29, 2024. Fourteen years. Rockstar Newswire

From the menu to the streets of Los Santos

By its October 4 update, the KytyPS5 team reported reaching GTA V gameplay in both Performance and Performance RT modes. That pins down what the team had demonstrated by October. The precise August timing shown on the card remains unverified. KytyPS5 developer update

Who put GTA VI on the roadmap?

A community member proposed a route toward testing GTA VI. That tells us what one contributor hoped to see. The post gives players no delivery date from the maintainers. Read the original discussion

What could slow down a playable version?

Getting through the opening menu answers one question. Driving across town, starting a mission, saving, and loading that save each exercise another part of the game. A useful GTA VI test would identify the build and show how far the tester actually got.

Could PC players mod GTA VI?

For players who kept GTA V installed for its mods, this may be the real reason to wait. An emulator reaching gameplay would still leave another question open. Who would build and maintain tools for that edition? Neither a GTA VI PC release nor mod support appears on Rockstar’s GTA VI page.

XFD’s pick in the race

We expect the emulator community to attempt GTA VI before Rockstar ships a PC edition. That is a prediction about who tries first. For someone waiting to play the story, a repeatable run through a mission would be a much more meaningful result.

What would make you stop waiting?

Would seeing Vice City boot on a PC be enough for you, or would you wait until you could finish a mission and reload your save? If you’re weighing a console purchase, our console versus PC breakdown covers the other side of that decision.
